blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: World Action Models (WAMs) typically represent the world through latent embeddings from pretrained video models, which entangle heterogeneous aspects of the world, from how it looks (e.g., texture and color) to how it is physically configured (e.g., occupancy and pose). This raises an underexplored question: $\textbf{what should constitute the state of a WAM?}$ We argue that the world state should separate how the world appears from how the world evolves under action: the former captures semantic context, while the latter is governed by physical state. To this end, we propose $\textbf{PrismWAM}$, which decouples physics from semantics while jointly modeling state and action. PrismWAM factorizes an embodied task into a $\mathrm{Semantic\ Planning}\rightarrow\mathrm{Physical\ Rollout}\rightarrow\mathrm{Executable\ Action}$ pipeline: given only the initial RGB observation, semantic planning learns to predict the final goal image, while physical rollout predicts the fine-grained evolution toward this goal in depth space; executable actions are then generated from the depth rollout. Without any embodied action pretraining or additional data augmentation, PrismWAM achieves strong manipulation performance in both simulation and the real world. Notably, PrismWAM even surpasses a broad range of models with large-scale embodied action pretraining (e.g., OpenWAM-$α$). More broadly, we reframe World Action Models from modeling how the world looks to how it responds to action, paving the way for action-centric world models grounded in occupancy, flow, tactile sensing, proprioception, and beyond.
blocks.zh: 世界行动模型(WAMS)通常通过预先训练的视频模型的潜在嵌入来代表世界,这些模型将世界的不同方面、世界的外观(例如纹理和颜色)以及世界的物理配置(例如占有和姿势)相缠绕在一起。 这引起了一个未充分探讨的问题:$\textbf{什么是WAM状态?}$ 我们主张,世界国家应该将世界的出现方式与行动下的世界演变方式分开:前者抓住语义背景,而后者则受物理状态所支配. 为此,我们提出$\textbf{PrismWAM}$, 将物理学与语义学脱钩,同时联合建模状态和行动. PrismWAM 将一个已包含的任务元素化为 $\ mathrm{Semantic\ 规划\ 右侧arrow\ mathrm{ 物理\ 推出\ 右侧arrow\ mathrm{ 可执行文件} Action}$ program:仅考虑到最初的RGB观测,语义规划学来预测最终目标图像,而物理推开则预测深度空间向这一目标方向的细微进化;然后从深度推出可执行动作. 在没有包含任何动作预训或附加数据增强的情况下,PrismWAM在模拟和现实世界中都实现了强大的操纵性能. 值得注意的是,棱晶水晶运动甚至超越了各种模型,并有大规模包含的动作预训(例如OpenWAM-$α美元)。 更广泛地说,我们把世界行动模式从模拟世界的展望转向如何对行动作出反应,为基于占用、流动、触觉感知、自主感知等以行动为中心的世界模式铺平道路。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: World models have emerged as a promising paradigm for enabling autonomous agents to predict the consequences of their actions ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ; LeCun, 2022 ) . By learning how the world evolves over time, these models aim to provide a foundation for planning and action ( Hafner et al., 2019 ) . Recent World Action Models (WAMs) extend this paradigm by jointly modeling video and action, often relying on pretrained video backbones to capture the rich visual dynamics of the physical world ( Ye and others, 2026 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Ye et al., 2026 ) . Yet, a key question remains underexplored: are video latents truly the most appropriate representations for world states?
blocks.zh: 世界模式已成为让自主代理能够预测其行动后果的有希望范例(Ha和Schmidhuber,2018;LeCun,2022)。 通过了解世界如何随时间演变,这些模型旨在为规划和行动提供基础(Hafner等,2019年). 最近的世界行动模式(WAMS)通过联合建模视频和行动来扩展这一范式,经常依靠经过预先训练的视频骨干来捕捉实体世界丰富的视觉动态(Ye等,2026;Li等,2026b; Ye等, 2026 (英语). 然而,一个关键问题仍然没有得到充分探讨:视频潜入是否真正是世界各国最恰当的表述?

blocks.en: Our key observation is that video latents capture a mixture of factors that are not equally relevant to action generation ( NVIDIA and others, 2025b ) . While appearance and texture provide rich semantic context for understanding the scene, they are often invariant to the actions being modeled. For example, when an agent moves or grasps an object, its geometry and pose may change, while its color, texture, and intrinsic appearance typically remain unchanged. Therefore, video latents which entangles the physical state with the semantic context can make the representation substantially richer than what is necessary for modeling how the world evolves under action.
blocks.zh: 我们的主要观察是,视频潜入物包含了一些与行动生成不同等相关的因素(NVIDIA等,2025b)。 虽然外观和纹理为理解场景提供了丰富的语义上下文,但往往对被建模的动作不具有变化. 例如,当一个代理人移动或抓住一个物体时,它的几何和姿势可能会改变,而它的颜色,纹理和内在外观则一般保持不变. 因此,将物理状态与语义背景相缠绕的影视潜想,可以使这种表现比模拟世界在行动下如何演变所必需的内容更加丰富。

blocks.en: This motivates a simple principle: a good state representation in WAMs should distinguish between physical state and semantic context. The physical state refers to action-relevant properties such as geometry, pose, occupancy, contact, and potentially dynamics, whereas semantic context provides the appearance information necessary to interpret that state, such as object identity, category, and texture; see Fig. (a). The distinction is not between information that is useful and useless; rather, it decouples what actions can change from what helps us understand what is being acted upon .
blocks.zh: 这激励了一个简单的原则:在WAMs中良好的状态代表应该区分物理状态和语义背景. 物理状态指与动作相关的属性,如几何,姿势,占用,接触,以及潜在的动态等,而语义上下文提供了解释该状态所必要的外观信息,如物体身份,类别和纹理等;参见图. (a). 区别不是在有用和无用的信息之间;而是将哪些行动可以改变与哪些帮助我们了解正在采取的行动脱钩。

blocks.en: Therefore, we propose PrismWAM to separate semantic context from physical dynamics through a Semantic ​ Planning → Physical ​ Rollout → Executable ​ Action \mathrm{Semantic~Planning}\rightarrow\mathrm{Physical~Rollout}\rightarrow\mathrm{Executable~Action} workflow (see Fig. (b)), rather than treating a single video latent as a monolithic state. Semantic planning infers what should happen in the end from RGB observations, physical rollout models how the world physically evolves toward the goal, and executable action determines how to make it happen . We instantiate this principle with a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT) architecture built upon a pretrained video backbone ( Team Wan and others, 2025 ) , as shown in Fig. 1 . During training, the semantic planner predicts the target from the initial RGB observation and transfers its task-level knowledge to the physical rollout via attention layers, while the action branch learns to map the predicted physical evolution to continuous actions. We use depth as the physical representation for its accessibility, physical grounding, and spatial alignment with RGB. Notably, the semantic planner serves only as a training-time teacher, with action inference relying solely on the initial RGB observation and learned depth rollout.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们提议PrismWAM通过语义规划_物理推出_可执行动作\mathrm{Semantic_Planning\rightarrow\mathrm{Physical_Rollout\rightarrow\mathrm{可执行动作}工作流程将语义上下文与物理动态区分开来(参见图(b)),而不是将单一视频潜伏状态作为单一状态处理。 语义规划从RGB的观察中推断出最终会发生什么, 我们用一个以预先训练的视频主干(Team Wan等, 2025年)为基础的转换器(MoT)架构, 1 (英语). 在训练期间,语义规划师从最初的RGB观察中预测出目标,并将其任务层面的知识通过关注层转移到物理展开上,而动作分支则学习将预测的物理进化图映射为连续动作. 我们使用深度作为获取、实际地面和空间与RGB一致的实际代表。 值得注意的是,语义规划师只是培训时间的教师,行动推论完全依赖于最初的RGB观察和所学到的深度推广.

blocks.en: Extensive experiments across diverse simulation and real-world benchmarks validate the effectiveness and efficiency of PrismWAM. (1) Without action pretraining, PrismWAM substantially outperforms representative VLAs and WAMs under the same setting, improving the success rate over FastWAM by 43.82 percentage points ( 83.67 83.67 vs. 39.85 39.85 ) on RoboTwin-C2R and the score over starVLA by 29.83 points ( 36.23 36.23 vs. 6.40 6.40 ) on RoboDojo; see Fig. (c). (2) PrismWAM outperforms several WAMs, including models with action pretraining, with particularly strong gains in precision manipulation and generalization: on RoboDojo Precision, it surpasses OpenWAM- α \alpha by 21.37 points ( 39.82 39.82 vs. 18.45 18.45 ), while improving the success rate on RoboTwin-C2R by 14.62 percentage points ( 83.67 83.67 vs. 69.05 69.05 ), showing a higher ceiling for complex tasks and novel scenes. (3) PrismWAM even matches or surpasses large-scale pretrained models on several benchmarks despite being trained with only ∼ \sim 2,300 hours of depth data. On RoboDojo, it improves the score by 16.00 points over G0.5 ( 36.23 36.23 vs. 20.23 20.23 ) and 16.16 points over Xiaomi-Robotics-1 ( 36.23 36.23 vs. 20.07 20.07 ), showing that scaling action pretraining is not the only path to stronger embodied foundation models; principled architectural design offers a more data-efficient alternative. Our key contributions are listed as follows: • A decoupling principle for World Action Models. We identify the entanglement of semantics and physics in video latents as a fundamental limitation of existing WAMs, forcing action generation to disentangle high-level task planning from fine-grained physical state transitions. • An effective and efficient WAM architecture. We instantiate the principle with a Mixture-of-Transformers (MoT), where an RGB semantic planner guides depth-based physical rollout, and develop a learning pipeline combining dense depth supervision with sparse RGB goal supervision, enabling fast inference without explicit RGB goal prediction. • Strong performance and data efficiency. PrismWAM outperforms existing VLAs and WAMs, with particularly strong gains in precision manipulation and generalization. It also surpasses a number of models with large-scale action pretraining, demonstrating that principled architectural design offers a more data-efficient path toward stronger embodied foundation models.
blocks.zh: 各种模拟和现实世界基准的广泛实验验证了棱镜世界运动的效力和效率。 (1) 不进行动作前训练,棱镜卫星在相同环境下的优于代表性VLA和WAM,比RoboTwin-C2R的FastWAM成功率提高了43.82个百分点(83.67对39.85 39.85),比取星VLA成功率提高了29.83分(36.23 36.23对6.40 6.40;见图(c). blocks.en: 2 Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: Vision-Language-Action Policies. The general and embodied knowledge encoded in pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) ( Comanici et al., 2025 ; Bai et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Xiaomi Embodied Intelligence Team, 2025 ) provides a foundation for vision-language-action (VLA) models that map visual observations and language instructions to robot actions ( Brohan et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Black and others, 2024 ; Li and others, 2024 ; Physical Intelligence et al., 2025 ; NVIDIA and others, 2025a ; Shukor et al., 2025 ) . Internet-scale image–text pretraining provides semantic priors for complex instruction understanding and long-horizon manipulation ( Brohan et al., 2023 ; Black and others, 2024 ; Physical Intelligence et al., 2025 ; NVIDIA and others, 2025a ; Shi and others, 2025 ) . However, such pretraining emphasizes recognition and semantic alignment, with limited explicit supervision for continuous state transitions and how actions change the environment.
blocks.zh: 愿景-语言-行动政策。 以预先训练过的视觉语言模型(VLMs)编码的一般和所体现知识(Comanici等,2025年;Bai等,2025年;Li等,2026a;Wang等,2026b;Xiaomi Embody Intelligence Team,2025年)为视觉语言行动模型提供了基础,这些模型描绘了对机器人行动的视觉观察和语言指示(Brohan等,2023年;Kim等,2024年;Black等,2024年)。 2024;Li等,2024;物理情报等,2025;NVIDIA等,2025a;Shukor等,2025; 互联网规模图像-文本预训为复杂的教学理解和长视距操纵提供了语义学前科(Brohan等,2023年;Black等,2024年;物理智能等,2025年;NVIDIA等,2025年a;Shi等,2025年). 然而,这种预训强调承认和语义一致,对持续的国家过渡以及对行动如何改变环境的明确监督有限。

blocks.en: World Action Models. Advances in video generative models ( Team Wan and others, 2025 ; NVIDIA and others, 2025b ; NVIDIA, 2026 ) have paved the way for world action models (WAMs), a promising paradigm that jointly models future states and robot actions for generalist robotic manipulation. Most jointly model future RGB observations and action sequences ( Zhu et al., 2025 ; Kim et al., 2026 ) . Some methods guide actions based on predicted future RGB observations ( Shen et al., 2025 ; Bi et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026b ; Ye and others, 2026 ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . Others use future prediction as training supervision and generate actions directly from observed context ( Yuan et al., 2026 ; Ye et al., 2026 ; Fang et al., 2026 ; Gu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) . Both approaches primarily learn state evolution in RGB appearance space, which entangles action-relevant geometry and pose with texture, illumination, and background. This requires modeling appearance details that may be irrelevant to control and inferring physical changes from visual variations that may not reflect motion ( Qiu et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) .
blocks.zh: 世界行动模式。 视频基因模型(Team Wan等,2025年;NVIDIA等,2025b;NVIDIA,2026年)的进步为世界行动模型(WAMS)铺平了道路,而世界行动模型是一个充满希望的范式,它联合了未来状态和机器人行动的模式来进行通用机器人操纵. 大多数共同模拟未来的RGB观测和动作序列(Zhu等,2025;Kim等,2026.). 一些方法指导根据预测的未来RGB观测结果采取的行动(沈等,2025;毕等,2025;李等,2026b;叶等,2026;许等,2026;张等,2026b;王等,2026a). 其他人则利用未来的预测作为培训监督,并直接从观测到的背景产生行动(袁等,2026;叶等,2026;方等,2026;顾等,2026;张等,2026a.). 这两种方法主要学习RGB外观空间的状态演化,这些演化将与动作相关的几何相缠绕并用纹理,发光和背景来摆出. 这需要模型化的外观细节,这些细节可能与控制和推断可能不反映运动的外观变化无关(邱等,2026;张等,2026a) 。 。 。 。

blocks.en: Physical Representations for Manipulation. Physical or spatial representations support precise manipulation and spatial generalization ( Shridhar et al., 2022 ; Goyal and others, 2023 ; Ze et al., 2024 ; Ke et al., 2024 ; Qu and others, 2025 ) . Such information can directly guide action generation through depth or point-cloud features extracted from current observations ( Yuan et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ; Ke et al., 2024 ) . Complementary approaches introduce physical or spatial structure through supervision, including representation alignment ( Li et al., 2025b ; Wu et al., 2026 ; Shi et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) and auxiliary prediction ( Guo et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026c ; Zhang et al., 2026a ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 操纵物理代表. 物理或空间表示支持精确操纵和空间通化(Shridhar等,2022;Goyal等,2023;Ze等,2024;Ke等,2024;Qu等,2025). 此类信息可以通过从当前观测中提取的深度或点-云特征直接指导行动生成(袁等,2025;李等,2025a; Ke等, 2024 (英语). 补充方法通过监督引入物理或空间结构,包括代表协调(Li等,2025年b; Wu等,2026;Shi等,2026;Yang等,2026)和辅助预测(Guo等,2026;Li等,2026c; 张等,2026a; 张等, 2025.).

blocks.en: Recent world action models take RGB and geometry as joint inputs and predict their future states together ( Zhao et al., 2026 ; Lopetegui Gonzalez et al., 2026 ) . This couples semantic and physical information, retaining the RGB-based modeling issues discussed above. PrismWAM separates their roles along a Semantic ​ Planning → Physical ​ Rollout → Executable ​ Action \mathrm{Semantic\ Planning}\rightarrow\mathrm{Physical\ Rollout}\rightarrow\mathrm{Executable\ Action} chain, distinguishing semantic task understanding from the physical state evolution that guides action execution.
blocks.zh: 最近的世界行动模型将RGB和几何学作为联合投入,并共同预测其未来状态(赵等,2026;Lopetegui Gonzalez等,2026)。 这种夫妇语义和物理信息,保留了上文讨论的基于RGB的模型问题. PrismWAM 沿着语义规划 ~ 物理推出 ~ 可执行动作\ mathrm{ 语义\ 规划\ rightarrow\ mathrm{ 物理= 推出\\ 右侧arrow\ mathrm{ 可执行文件\ Action}链条,区分语义任务理解与指导动作执行的物理状态演化.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: PrismWAM follows a Semantic ​ Planning → Physical ​ Rollout → Executable ​ Action \mathrm{Semantic\ Planning}\rightarrow\mathrm{Physical\ Rollout}\rightarrow\mathrm{Executable\ Action} chain for prediction and control. The RGB stream learns semantic planning representations from a sparse future-frame target, while the depth stream predicts a dense physical rollout that guides action generation. We first present the problem formulation (§ 3.1 ), then describe PrismWAM’s architecture, training, and inference (§ 3.2 ).
blocks.zh: PrismWAM 遵循语义规划 → 物理推出 → 可执行动作\ mathrm{ 语义上\ 规划\ 右旋\ mathrm{ 物理上\ 推出\\ 右侧arrow\ mathrm{ 可执行文件\ 行动 预测和控制链。 RGB流从稀疏的未来帧目标中学习语义规划表述,而深度流则预测出能指导动作生成的密集物理展开. 我们首先提出问题表述(第3.1节),然后描述棱镜世界运动的架构、培训和推论(第3.2节)。

Left : the RGB stream learns task semantics through sparse supervision from a single intended-future frame, while the depth stream predicts a dense geometric trajectory jointly with actions. Right : chain attention routes observed-RGB features to the depth stream and physical rollout features to the action tower.

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题的提出

blocks.en: We formulate a world–action model (WAM) that jointly predicts world-state evolution and the corresponding actions. Let x 0 x_{0} denote the current world state, x 1 : F x_{1:F} its future world state trajectory, and a 1 : H a_{1:H} the corresponding action sequence. Given task context c = ( ℓ , s ) c=(\ell,s) , comprising the language instruction ℓ \ell and proprioceptive state s s , the policy can be expressed as π θ ( a 1 : H ∣ x 0 , c ) = ∫ p θ ( a 1 : H ∣ x 1 : F , x 0 , c ) ⏟ action generation p θ ( x 1 : F ∣ x 0 , c ) ⏟ world-state evolution d x 1 : F . \pi_{\theta}(a_{1:H}\mid x_{0},c)=\int\underbrace{p_{\theta}(a_{1:H}\mid x_{1:F},x_{0},c)}_{\text{action generation}}\underbrace{p_{\theta}(x_{1:F}\mid x_{0},c)}_{\text{world-state evolution}}\,\mathrm{d}x_{1:F}. blocks.en: Building on the pretrained video backbone WAN ( Team Wan and others, 2025 ) , PrismWAM uses RGB and depth streams with asymmetric temporal supervision, coupled to an action tower through a mixture-of-transformers (MoT) architecture (Fig. 1 , left). The RGB stream predicts a single intended-future frame r F r_{F} , a sparse target for learning task semantics. The depth stream predicts the denser sequence d 1 : F d_{1:F} , providing intermediate spatial states that guide action evolution. This assigns semantic planning to sparse RGB prediction and physical rollout to dense geometric prediction, whose representation is less entangled with texture and illumination.
blocks.zh: PrismWAM在经过预先训练的视频主干网(Team Wan等,2025年)的基础上,采用有不对称时间监督的RGB和深度流,再与一个动作塔相接而成,通过混合变相器(MoT)架构(图1,左). RGB流预测一个单一的预定未来框架r F r r QQF},这是学习任务语义的稀有目标. 深度流会预测更密集的序列d 1:F d_{1:F},提供中间空间状态来引导动作进化. 这使得语义规划为稀疏的RGB预测和物理展开为稠密的几何预测,其表述与纹理和发光的缠绕较少.

blocks.en: The model receives RGB history r ≤ 0 r_{\leq 0} , current depth d 0 d_{0} , instruction ℓ \ell , and proprioception s s . Camera views are resized into matching RGB and depth mosaics, and RGB values and clipped metric depth are normalized. The frozen RGB and depth VAEs encode observations and future training targets into latent representations, which modality-specific patch projections convert into visual tokens. Frozen T5 embeddings and projected, normalized proprioception form the context C C , which all branches access through cross-attention. Appendix A.1 specifies input layouts and temporal sampling.

blocks.en: During joint training, the RGB token sequence combines clean history latents with noisy latents of the single future target, while the depth sequence combines clean current-depth latents with noisy future-depth latents. The action branch linearly projects each action vector in the noisy sequence into an action token. Gaussian corruption is applied only to prediction targets; observed RGB and depth remain fixed. Each branch receives its own noise-level embedding.

blocks.en: A structured attention mask controls information flow between these token groups (Fig. 1 , right). Within each visual stream, future tokens attend to observed tokens and one another, while observed tokens cannot read future tokens. Depth tokens additionally read only the observed-RGB tokens. Action tokens attend to one another and to both observed and future depth tokens, with no direct access to RGB. These cross-modal connections are directed: RGB does not read depth or actions, and depth does not read actions. Thus, action prediction uses evolving depth features without accessing the future-RGB target.

blocks.en: Without embodied action pretraining, we evaluate PrismWAM across five simulation benchmarks spanning both in-distribution manipulation and out-of-distribution transfer (§ 4.2 ). We further examine how our role-decoupled representations support control through robustness analyses, controlled ablations, and discussion (§ 4.3 ), and validate the approach in real-world manipulation (§ 4.4 ). Training settings and detailed benchmark results are provided in Appendices A.1 and B , respectively.

blocks.en: We evaluate in-distribution manipulation and out-of-distribution transfer across five simulation benchmarks: RoboTwin clean-to-random ( Chen and others, 2025 ) , LIBERO ( Liu et al., 2023 ) , LIBERO-Plus ( Fei et al., 2025 ) , LIBERO-Pro ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) , and RoboDojo ( Chen et al., 2026b ) . LIBERO assesses in-distribution manipulation under its standard protocol. RoboTwin clean-to-random, LIBERO-Plus, and LIBERO-Pro probe transfer across diverse visual, spatial, semantic, task, and environmental shifts, while RoboDojo evaluates manipulation capabilities using both task scores and success rates.

Hatched bars in fig. 2 denote pretrained models and methods fine-tuned from them. We additionally include top-performing benchmark-specific methods ( GigaBrain Team and others, 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Zhong et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Black and others, 2024 ; Liu and others, 2026 ; Xiaomi Robotics Team and others, 2026 ; Dexmal Team, 2026 ) . For RoboTwin-C2R, fig. 2 also includes ME-Dex-1.0 ( Zhang et al., 2026c ) , a leading entry on the official leaderboard as of October 19, 2026 ( RoboTwin Team, 2026 ) . ME-Dex-1.0 uses tactile supervision during training and zero tactile input at evaluation. Across five benchmarks, PrismWAM substantially outperforms the cross-benchmark baselines starVLA and FastWAM without embodied action pretraining . blocks.en: 4.3 Analysis and Discussion
blocks.zh: 4.3 分析和讨论

blocks.en: Depth encodes distance rather than texture or illumination, making it naturally insensitive to changes in color and lighting. This raises a key question: does physical-state prediction offer more than appearance robustness? Results across multiple benchmarks point to broader benefits for generalization and precise control. PrismWAM achieves 81.70% under layout perturbations on LIBERO-Plus, compared with 77.38% for OpenWAM- α \alpha and 66.49% for FastWAM; on LIBERO-Pro, it achieves 88.65% when object attributes such as size, shape, and color change, exceeding OpenWAM- α \alpha at 84.45% and FastWAM at 73.00% ( table 2 ). On RoboDojo’s challenging Precision tasks, PrismWAM substantially outperforms pretrained OpenWAM- α \alpha , achieving 19.50% success versus 9.25% ( table 2 ). These results suggest that physical-state prediction goes beyond appearance robustness: it supports broader generalization, as illustrated by robustness to changes in scene layout and object shape, and exposes physical structure for precise control .
blocks.zh: 深度编码了距离而不是纹理或发光,使其自然地对颜色和照明的变化不敏感. 这提出了一个关键问题:物理状态预测是否比外观坚固性更能提供? 跨越多个基准的结果表明,对普遍化和准确控制而言,有更广泛的好处。 PrismWAM在LIBERO-Plus的布局扰动下达到81.70%,而OpenWAM-α-α和FastWAM的扰动率为77.38%;在LIBERO-Pro的扰动下,在大小、形状和颜色变化等物体属性时达到88.65%,超过OpenWAM-α-α-α和FastWAM为84.45%(表2)。 在RoboDojo充满挑战的精密任务上,PrismWAM大大超越了预先训练的OpenWAM-α-alpha,取得了19.50%的成功率,而9.25%(表2)。 这些结果表明,物理状态预测超越了外观稳健性:它支持更广泛的概括性,表现为对场景布局和物体形状变化的稳健性,并暴露出物理结构以进行精确控制.

blocks.en: Real-world depth sensors may produce measurement noise and missing values, motivating evaluation with real-world-like depth corruption. The corruption profiles, which are informed by the manufacturers’ specifications for Orbbec Gemini 335 and RealSense D435, are controlled stress tests rather than calibrated models of either sensor; full settings are provided in section A.4 . As shown in fig. 3 , we train and evaluate PrismWAM on RoboTwin-C2R across three corruption levels constructed from Metric Jitter , Edge Missing , and Patch Hole . On randomized scenes, all three corruption levels reduce success relative to uncorrupted depth. In the clean setting, light corruption yields a small improvement before performance declines at higher severity. Nevertheless, even at the strongest corruption level, the average performance drops by only 2.45 pp. These results demonstrate that PrismWAM remains robust to diverse forms of depth corruption.

Removing either the RGB or depth stream reduces both clean-scene success and transfer, supporting the complementary roles of semantic context and physical state.
Direct RGB-to-action access improves clean-scene success but weakens transfer, while exposing depth to future RGB also reduces transfer, favoring the proposed chain from observed semantic context through physical rollout to action.
Together, these results support representation decoupling through complementary streams , with the full design achieving the best clean–random average.

blocks.en: PrismWAM achieves pooled success of 88.9% in ID and 68.6% in OOD, compared with 74.1% and 48.6% for OpenWAM, improving success by 14.8 and 20.0 percentage points, respectively. OOD gains hold across all three tasks: 86.7% versus 66.7% on Pick Up Plate, 60.0% versus 30.0% on Ranking Block Size, and 50.0% versus 40.0% on Open Microwave. In ID, PrismWAM improves plate handling and size ordering, while OpenWAM performs better on microwave retrieval (90.0% versus 80.0%). These results extend the scene-change robustness observed in simulation to physical manipulation, supporting the practical value of combining RGB semantic guidance with depth-based physical rollouts.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduce PrismWAM , a World Action Model built on the principle of decoupling semantic context from physical state. Rather than treating video latents as a monolithic world representation, PrismWAM decomposes world-action modeling into Semantic ​ Planning → Physical ​ Rollout → Executable ​ Action \mathrm{Semantic~Planning}\rightarrow\mathrm{Physical~Rollout}\rightarrow\mathrm{Executable~Action} : RGB future-frame prediction captures task-level intent, depth models physical state transitions, and the resulting rollout is mapped directly to continuous actions without RGB goal prediction at inference. Across diverse simulation and real-world manipulation benchmarks, PrismWAM achieves strong performance and generalization with only 2,300 hours of depth data and without embodied action pretraining, while matching or surpassing large-scale action-pretrained models on challenging settings. These results suggest that scaling action data is not the only path to stronger embodied foundation models; principled state representations and architectural design offer a more data-efficient alternative. More broadly, PrismWAM paves the way for a new generation of WAMs that shifts the focus from modeling how the world looks to how the world responds to action . While depth is one practical realization of this principle, it can extend to occupancy, flow, tactile sensing, proprioception, and other representations capturing action-induced state transitions.
blocks.zh: PrismWAM是一个世界行动模式,它建立在语义上与物理状态脱钩的原则上。 PrismWAM 将世界行动模型分解成语义规划 → 物理推出 → 可执行动作\mathrm{ semmantic}\ Planning\ rightarrow\ mathrm{ Physical}\ Rollout\ rightarrow\ mathrm{ 可执行动作} : RGB未来帧预测可以捕捉任务级别意图,深度模型物理状态过渡,由此而来展开的被直接映射为连续动作而无需推断RGB目标预测. 在整个不同的模拟和现实世界操纵基准中,PrismWAM以2,300小时的深度数据实现强性能和通俗化,没有包含动作前训练,同时在挑战性环境上匹配或超越大规模动作前训练模型. 这些结果表明,规模化行动数据并不是实现更有力体现的基础模型的唯一途径;原则性的国家表述和建筑设计提供了更具有数据效率的替代办法。 PrismWAM为新一代WAM铺平了道路, 虽然深度是这一原则的一个实际实现,但它可以延伸至占用、流动、触觉感知、自发性以及其他反映行动引起的国家过渡的表述。

blocks.en: At present, large-scale real-world manipulation data with synchronized depth observations remains relatively limited, which constrains the scale of depth pretraining compared with existing action-pretrained models. We view this primarily as a reflection of the current data landscape: as depth sensing becomes more accessible and embodied datasets incorporate richer physical modalities, such data is likely to become increasingly available. Physical-state pretraining may therefore emerge as a natural scaling direction for World Action Models, with PrismWAM taking an early step toward establishing this new paradigm.
blocks.zh: 目前,带有同步深度观测的大规模现实世界操纵数据仍然相对有限,这与现有的动作预训模型相比,限制了深度预训的规模. 我们认为这主要反映了当前的数据格局:随着深度感知越来越容易获得,并且包含着更丰富的物理模式的数据集,这些数据很可能变得越来越容易获得。 因此,物理状态前培训可以作为世界行动模式的自然推广方向而出现,棱镜运动为建立这一新模式迈出了第一步。

blocks.en: A.2 Depth-VAE Training Recipe
blocks.zh: A.2 深度-增值 培训辅助工具

blocks.en: We train Wan2.2-compatible and Wan2.1-compatible single-channel depth VAEs with 48 and 16 latent channels, respectively. Each is initialized from its corresponding pretrained RGB VAE ( Team Wan and others, 2025 ) , averaging the RGB input and output boundary weights across channels while retaining matching internal weights. Their spatial compression factors are 16 and 8, respectively. We additionally train a head-view-only depth VAE for real-world setups without wrist-view depth. The depth VAEs remain frozen throughout downstream policy training.
blocks.zh: 我们分别以48个和16个潜在通道培训Wan2.2相容和Wan2.1相容的单通道深度VAE。 每一个都从相应的预训RGB VAE(Team Wan等,2025年)中初始化出来,平均RGB输入和输出跨通道的边界权重同时保留匹配的内部权重. 它们的空间压缩系数分别为16和8. 我们额外训练一个只看头的深度 VAE 为现实世界的设置,没有腕景深度。 在整个下游政策培训中,VAE的深度仍然被冻结。

blocks.en: We use processed AgiBotWorld-Beta depth ( Bu et al., 2025 ) and simulated RoboTwin depth from clean and randomized demonstrations ( Chen and others, 2025 ) . After additional filtering of AgiBotWorld-Beta, the combined corpus contains approximately 2,300 hours of depth sequences. We sample AgiBotWorld-Beta and RoboTwin with probabilities 0.75 and 0.25, respectively, then sample a valid temporal clip with replacement. Training augmentation comprises random temporal cropping, in-plane rotation within ± 5 ∘ \pm 5^{\circ} , and horizontal flipping with probability 0.5, applied consistently across frames and views.
blocks.zh: 我们使用经过加工的AgiBotWorld-Beta深度(Bu等,2025年), 在对AgiBotWorld-Beta进行额外过滤后,综合体包含了大约2300小时的深度序列. 我们用概率分别为0.75和0.25的AgiBotWorld-Beta和RoboTwin进行取样,然后用替换来取样一个有效的时间夹. 培训强化包括随机抽取时间、飞机在 ± 5\pm 5\circ} 内旋转,以及横向翻转,概率为 0.5, 横跨框架和观点。

blocks.en: Perturbation Setting. We corrupt metric depth at three severity levels ( figs. 3 and 8 ). Edge Missing removes pixels around depth discontinuities exceeding 30 mm, using dilation radii of 1, 5, or 7 pixels and nominal removal fractions of 24–25%, modulated by depth at Levels 2–3. Patch Hole is enabled at Levels 2–3: each camera receives at most one connected hole targeting 1.5% of valid pixels per event, with a duration of 4–8 frames and onset offsets of 16–32 frames within each 80-frame cycle.

blocks.en: A.5 Real-World Evaluation

blocks.en: Training. Both policies train on the same demonstrations for 30k total updates with a global batch size of 256 and seed 42. PrismWAM is initialized from Wan2.2-5B and uses 15k depth-only adaptation updates followed by 15k joint RGB/depth/action updates; OpenWAM- α \alpha uses 30k RGB/action updates. For setups without wrist-view depth, PrismWAM uses the separately pretrained head-view-only depth VAE with 256 × 320 256\times 320 inputs (Appendix A.2 ). The VAEs and T5 remain frozen during policy training. PrismWAM predicts absolute joint commands, and OpenWAM- α \alpha predicts absolute end-effector targets.
blocks.zh: 培训。 两项政策都以同样的示范方式进行培训,总共更新30k,全球批量规模为256个,种子42个。 PrismWAM由Wan2.2-5B初始化而来,使用15k只深度的适应更新,之后使用15k联合RGB/深度/动作更新;OpenWAM-α\α使用30kRGB/动作更新. 对于没有手腕-视图深度的设置,PrismWAM使用单独预训的头视图-只深VAE,有256×320 256\times 320输入(Appendix A.2. VAE和T5在政策培训期间仍然被冻结. PrismWAM预测绝对联合指令,而OpenWAM-α-α预测绝对最终效果目标.

blocks.en: Embodiment and data. We use single-arm and dual-arm Piper-X configurations, each equipped with one head-view RGB-D camera (Orbbec Gemini 335). Ranking Block Size uses a single arm, while Pick Up Plate and Open Microwave use both arms. For these three tasks, we collect 100 demonstration episodes for Open Microwave , 200 for Pick Up Plate , and 180 for Ranking Block Size , with 30 episodes for each of the six size permutations. Each task has 50 goal-preserving training paraphrases.
blocks.zh: 活化与数据. 我们使用单臂和双臂Piper-X配置,每个配置有一个头视相机RGB-D相机(Orbbec双子座相机335). Ranking Block Sze使用单臂,而Pick Up Plate和Open Microwave则使用双臂. 对于这三项任务,我们收集了100集的演示片段为"Open Microwave",200集为"Pick Up Plate",180集为"Ranking Block Size",其中6个尺寸的平面各有30集. 每项任务都有50个目标保留训练的解说.

blocks.en: Tasks and evaluation. Success requires (i) Pick Up Plate : pick up the plate with both arms and place it on the rack; (ii) Ranking Block Size : place the largest cube farthest from the robot, the medium cube centrally, and the smallest nearest; (iii) Open Microwave : open the door, move the inside basket to the tabletop on the microwave’s right, and leave the door open. ID uses the original setup, including all six size permutations for Ranking Block Size . As illustrated in fig. 5 , OOD settings for all three tasks include flickering lights with ambient lights switched off and added distractor objects. blocks.zh: B.3. RoboDojo:类别、种子和任务成果

blocks.en: The simulation suite ( Chen et al., 2026b ) has 42 canonical tasks in five categories, represented by 54 standard/randomized entries per seed. Generalization uses 25 episodes/entry/seed; other categories use 50 (2100 episodes/seed, 6300 over seeds 0–2). Both policies use simulator depth, ten denoising steps, and replanning every 24 actions. We evaluate both policies with three seeds (0–2). Table 13 reports category and overall Score/SR as mean ± \pm population standard deviation across seeds, together with each seed’s overall result; overall metrics average the five categories equally. reports per-entry Score/SR averaged over the same three seeds.
